summary: Phase 4b (Stripe TEST mode billing + admin Money + admin E-mail + home-v-away) tested end to end. Backend: new test_phase4b_billing_email.py has 14 passed and 1 skipped (the refund-reason API test; a payment now exists). The full Stripe flow works in preview. Signed-out Choose Pro goes to sign-in. Signed in, Choose Pro opens checkout.stripe.com. Paying with card 4242 returns to /account/plan?status=success, billing-confirming shows, and the webhook arrives in about 2s: plan-name becomes 'Pro' with status Trialing (5-day trial). Manage billing opens billing.stripe.com and the portal works. Admin screens all work: plan sync shows a toast, cancel at period end works (webhook gives 'trialing (ends)', and the user page then says 'Ends on'), the refund dialog needs a reason, the coupon TEST10 can be created and switched off, revenue tiles show for CAD, and templates edit/preview/reset, the empty blocked-addresses list and campaign draft save all work. Home v away order is correct on /insights (all 13 cards checked against the matches collection) and on /match (Torino v Como, Como cards read 'Torino v Como'). No page overflow at 390px on pricing, account plan, or the 8 admin money/e-mail screens and the coupon drawer. Found 5 frontend bugs, listed below.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {status:'skipped_disabled'} when e-mail is off. The UI treats any 200 as a success (see frontend). Return a 409 EMAIL_OFF style error, or have the UI check the status.
Rows have no member e-mail (only user_id), so the Member column shows a hex id. Field names also differ from what the UI reads (current_period_end vs period_end; amount_paid vs amount_cents).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Send test to me' shows a success toast 'Test sent to your inbox' while e-mail is off (backend status skipped_disabled). The review asks for a clear error. Fix: check r.status !== 'sent' and setErr/toast an error such as 'E-mail sending is off'.
The amount column and the refund dialog body show 'No data' because the UI reads r.amount_cents but payment docs store amount_paid. Expected '0.00 CAD'.
'Period ends' shows 'No data' because the UI reads r.period_end but the doc has current_period_end (2026-10-31). Member shows user_id, not e-mail.

After Reset, the DB and list go back to Default, but the drawer fields keep the edited subject ('TEST_UI ...'). The edit state is not cleared and q is not reloaded, so pressing Save would re-apply the old edit.
The lead text is hard-coded: 'Paid plans are off. While billing is off every signed-in person gets the top plan.' It shows even though features.billing is true.

issues: The Free card shows '$0' (USD format) while Pro shows 'CA$9.99'. Use the plan currency.
The Pro 5-day free trial is not mentioned on the pricing card; it only appears on Stripe checkout.
Stripe Checkout charges in USD by default (adaptive pricing, US$7.41), while the app shows CAD. Turn off adaptive pricing in Stripe if CAD-only is wanted.
Shows 'Renews on Oct 31' during the trial; 'Trial ends on' would be clearer.
The Confirming setInterval keeps polling every 2s forever after the 30s fallback; it should stop after the late message.
The Refund button is enabled for a 0.00 trial invoice; the click gives 'This payment has no payment or charge id.' Disable it when amount_paid is 0.

action_items: Email.jsx tpl-test: show an error when the response status is not 'sent' (e.g. skipped_disabled gives 'E-mail sending is off'), or make the backend return a 4xx.
Money.jsx Payments: use amount_paid (or map amount_cents in the backend list_payments).
Money.jsx Subscriptions: use current_period_end (or map period_end in the backend), and join the user e-mail in list_subscriptions and list_payments.
Email.jsx Editor: after Reset (and after Save), clear the edit state and reload the template query.
Plans.jsx: make the PageHead lead depend on features.billing.
Pricing: format the Free price in the plan currency; mention the trial days.
Account Confirming: clear the interval after the late message, or after a maximum number of polls.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.template_test returns 200 for every skipped_* status, so the UI cannot tell success from failure.
admin_queries.list_subscriptions and list_payments return raw docs. Field names do not match the Money.jsx columns, which is the cause of the 'No data' cells.
RefundBody.reason has no min_length; the reason check only happens in stripe_billing.refund (after the payment lookup). Add min_length=3 in Pydantic.
Pricing.jsx always shows the 'Test mode: use card 4242...' text; it should depend on billing.mode == 'test'.
Account Confirming never stops polling when the webhook does not arrive.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (5 display bugs, all core flows work)

rca of the issue: 'No data' cells: Money.jsx reads amount_cents and period_end, but the Stripe webhook handler stores amount_paid and current_period_end, and admin_queries.paged returns raw docs. tpl-test false success: emailer._deliver returns {'status':'skipped_disabled'} with HTTP 200 and Email.jsx act() only catches thrown errors. Stale editor after reset: Editor keeps its local edit state and onSaved only reloads the parent list.
